question: What attainment follows from abandoning the mass of conceptualization?
premises: The mass of conceptualization is abandoned.
A state of dissolution into the kula-less hero is reached.
Those who reach it are described as having gone there.
inference: Abandoning conceptualization leads to dissolution into the kula-less hero.
plain_english: Having abandoned the mass of conceptualization, they have gone to dissolution in the kula-less hero.
